title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A subscriber written into a JSON fixture
summary: The quick fix that adds an event subscriber aimed at the last brace of the file text, which can sit inside a string or a comment.

highlights.title: Inserted into the data, not the class
highlights.description: Six files of a real project end with a raw string holding a JSON fixture. The subscriber went inside it: the file still compiles, the method does not exist, and the fixture is corrupted.

highlights.title: A handler name learned from a comment
highlights.description: The fix copies the handler name from the subscriber already in the file so it matches the bus in use. A commented out one counted.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The subscriber is inserted before the closing brace of the last class, never inside a string or a comment.
The handler name is learned from real code only.
The import decision reads the same cleaned text.
